email.subject: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) recruiting — war-focused, tracked, and built to last (2600+)
email.body:
Hey!

POAP KINGS is recruiting players at 2600+ trophies. We’re a builder-minded clan with a serious competitive edge in Clan Wars — and we run the clan like it matters.

Quick snapshot (durable stats):
- Clan: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG)
- Members: 44
- Combined trophies: 314,070
- Weekly donations: 3,516
- Avg member level: 42.1
- Clan War trophies: 220

What makes us different:
- POAP culture (Proof of Attendance / “Proof of Arena Push”): we treat seasons + milestones like they should be remembered.
- A real reward tradition: our War Champ earns a Free Pass Royale (criteria can vary by season, but it’s always rare and earned).
- We track wars and milestones with our own systems (yes, the clan even has “Elixir” helping keep records and momentum).

People you’ll actually recognize in chat:
- raquaza (Co-Leader) — Witch + Boss Bandit. War leader energy and our current top war fame at 10,250.
- King Levy (Co-Leader) — The Log + Ice Spirit. Clean fundamentals, steady leadership.
- Vijay (Elder) — Zap + Valkyrie. 13,000 trophies and consistent war output.
- Chanco (Elder) — Inferno Dragon + Witch. 367 donations and always showing up.
- gooba — donation machine (452 donations) keeping requests moving.

What we want from new members:
- Be active and respectful. Low-drama only.
- Donate when you can.
- If you join war, we push for full effort (real life comes first, but we value reliability).

If that sounds like your kind of clan, check us out and hop in:
https://poapkings.com
